notes.title: Small patch - More health less damage, bug fixes(again)
notes.content:
AI Improvements
The local Jarl's have grown tired of being the laughing stock of the entire game so they have upgraded themselves to be more formidable. 

AI Jarls now get passives

AI Jarls stats scale based on the year


Bug fixes
Fixed bug where a rune was dragging when you were dragging a Viking


Balance 
Due to a majority of fights being quick and one Viking cleaving entire teams, I have adjusted the following activities to help shift to more strategic fights to really show your clans builds.

All Vikings health has been increased by 100

All Vikings base armor has been doubled

Merging Vikings now grants 20% of the merged Vikings stats(ex you merge a Viking that has 100 hp, it adds 20 hp to the Viking instead of 100)

Gold gained from killing Viking has been lowered from 2 to 1

Gold gained from the Goldmine has been increased across the board by 20-50%

Goldmine negative effects have been toned down, TNT blast still is high risk, high reward

Blacksmith rank effect has been changed from +1/+2 per rank to be +1 extra smash per rank. 



All player fights have been removed from the database to adjust for new balancing.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed bug in ritual site where you could drag Viking after you sacrifice

Fixed bug in Odin Trail where you could drag after you started the trial

Fixed bug when you moved Viking from Odin Trial and Ritual site from the selected spot it would snap back but it wouldn't register it was in the selected spot

Fixed bug where you lock the ritual site

Oathforged passive now correctly displays that it targets the front warrior

Updated tooltip for Voyage to show it unlocks in year 5 not 4

Updating match making system to help better match players in the first few years

notes.title: Update #1 - Balance changes and bug fixs, resetting database
notes.content:
Fixed the tavern bug preventing you from upgrading.

Add rank nodes to Blacksmith, Hunting Grounds, Ritual and Goldmines.

Changed cleave damage to be 30% on adjacent targets.

Added in the Voyage nodes.

Lowered the rune stat amounts to align better with the new stat scaling.



I will be resetting the database later today to remove all clans using the old stat scaling.

notes.title: Small fixes and updated Jarl's
notes.content:
Replaced Jarl's that we're enhanced using AI with non AI ones.

Added a speed up combat setting

Fixed audio bug from runes not getting muted with sfx volume was down

Fixed an exploit in Odin's Trail

Added an Elk to the Hunting Grounds

notes.title: Small patch: Adding double combat speed option
notes.content: Adding a new setting to speed up combat speed. Fixed some other text issues in the mines. I think I have addressed the tavern issues with Vikings getting removed when you merge units.

notes.title: Small Patch - Database improvements
notes.content:
Small update, database was getting hammered so I have fixed the query call to less stressful on the backend. Should not impact anything in game but will drop my read consumption a lot. 

Thanks to everyone has played and provided feedback on bugs and other issues. I will be address some of these bugs soon. Just trying to get the backend stable for the increased load from everyone playing now.



I also added in a small new mechanic for the hunting grounds. 



-New Hunting Grounds Mechanic - Well Feed

If you gather 20 or more rations from hunting, your clan is well feed

Well feed give you a random rune



I also fixed your Jarl's name now being correct in the tavern.



Thanks everyone who has played!

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixed raid issue
notes.content: Raids were crashing the game after you finished the fight. Should be working now.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Adjusted Tideblade base stats

Increased max hp from 140 to 160

Lowered speed from 21 to 14

Lowered damage from 57 to 35

Raised armor from 7 to 20

Adjusted Stoneguard

Lowered armor gained from 20 to 15



Increased all stat runes base values by 2-3 times, except for speed



Fixed some spelling issues on passives

notes.title: Small patch, new node
notes.content:
Small patch



New Node: 

Odin's Mercy: Gain 2 lives, usable only once. Can only be used before year 6 and when on 1 life.

Fix to bloodlust passive, not triggering when Vikings were bleeding

Fixed icons not spawning for energy and life nodes

notes.title: Version 36 - All AI images have been removed, new starting passive
notes.content:
⚔️ Patch Notes – Version 36

🔥 Major Changes
All AI-generated artwork has been removed from the game and store.
We’ve fully transitioned to handcrafted, original art to preserve the integrity and atmosphere of Raidbound.
[hr][/hr]🧬 New Feature – Jarl Synergy System
Your chosen Jarl now grants role-based synergy bonuses to your crew from the start of the game:

Raider: +10% Damage

Warden: +15% Armor

Skirmisher: +1 Speed, +5% Damage

Berserker: +3 Speed

These bonuses stack with role effects and offer deeper strategic choices from the first turn.
[hr][/hr]🌟 New System – Experience & Progression
A brand-new experience system has been added:

Gain XP from every action you take across battles, training, and exploration.

Unlock additional Jarls as you level up.

More unlocks and progression rewards coming soon!

notes.title: ⚔️ Raidbound Patch Notes – The Great Overhaul
notes.content:
Prepare yourselves, Jarls! This week brings our largest visual update yet. Nearly every piece of the game’s UI has been reforged, and the Viking warriors you command have shed their AI-born past for hand-crafted glory. The old gods approve.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667601/983ef4ce8d7645760fb30a16a52455722940f1f7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667601/7054ef910b6a6593d74b3f0dcc9a10aefeaefc1c.png"]
🌄 Major Changes
All-New UI Across the Game
Every menu and screen has been reworked from the ground up. Cleaner, sharper, and more immersive than ever.

New Hover & Click Effects
UI elements now respond with satisfying effects when hovered or clicked—feels like real craftsmanship.

New Viking Art
The AI-era is nearly gone. All Vikings have been visually remade with handcrafted sprites to match the Raidbound style.
(We’re almost fully free of AI art—just a few relics left to purge.)
🌀 Effects & Feedback
New Rune Appear Effects
Runes now emerge with a divine flourish worthy of their power.

Ritual Site Visual Upgrade
New visual effects to capture the mystery and weight of sacrifice.

Odin’s Trial Visual Upgrade
The gods watch more closely now—expect a more dramatic experience.

Improved Drag-and-Drop Logic
Items now ease back into place if not dropped into a valid slot. Smooth as a serpent.
🔧 Quality of Life
Tutorial Hovering/Text Clean-Up
Clarity improved across the early-game guide. Fewer words, more wisdom.

Fixed SFX Labeling Issues
Misplaced sound effects have been sorted into their proper categories.

Faster Resource Gathering
Mining and gathering times have been sped up. Your warriors work with newfound purpose.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you to everyone testing, reporting, and playing. More updates soon—especially as we continue to purge the last remnants of AI from the world of Raidbound.

notes.title: ⚔️ Raidbound Patch Notes – Glory and Gold Update
notes.content:
🆕 New Additions
🎵 Gamblers Den now has music – Let the drums of fate play as you wager your gold, rations… or honor.

🌊 New backgrounds added for both Sparring Pit and Raid encounters, bringing fresh life to your trials.

🃏 Voyage screen cards now animate – Your journey begins with style.
⚙️ Visual Improvements
💀 Victory & Defeat screens enhanced to better reflect your triumph… or demise.

🟡 Gold Mine animations improved, including a new setup effect to highlight the start of your dig.

✨ Rune cards received a visual polish, now glowing with newfound power.

🖱️ Hover and click effects added to all cards – sharpen your senses before battle begins.
🔥 Combat Changes
👁️ Odin’s Wraith is now more visible and threatening – After 45 seconds in battle, ramping damage will begin until only one clan remains. Stay swift, or perish under his gaze.

A fresh update is live — and with it, a new node to test your luck and your nerve.
